Accepted baseline / restored 2 Nov 2026

Dynamics owns the call from the first ring

The caller dials the Dynamics number. Copilot retains call and language control while Azure attaches HUMAIN to that same conversation. A human request goes to the native Dynamics queue, not an operator phone number.

Not a production certification. One native AI call at a time, with a 20-minute active AI phase. The accepted recording-notice path is restored. The 5-7 second first-audio delay is work in progress, on hold; the latency optimization and native music trials are not the deployment target.

Proposed architecture

Production overview

Customer telephony connects through Azure to HUMAIN for AI voice calls and Dynamics 365 Contact Center for human assistance.

Separate future topology. The native path already has Dynamics-owned calls and Dataverse CRM. This proposal instead adds customer-SBC ingress, enterprise API management and durable workflows. Those extensions are not deployed. The drawing retains the earlier ACS Direct Routing design, not a lifecycle-approved deployment target.

External-IVR proposal / not the native call path

Voice & handover

This future sequence starts outside Dynamics and transfers audio plus a context reference into a Dynamics workstream. Its SIP/UUI adapter and acceptance callback are not implemented.

Do not reuse this release ordering for the native path. The accepted native path already belongs to Dynamics. It detaches the application's two legs before TransferToAgent; representative acceptance follows. There is no external-IVR transcript-import adapter on that path.

Proposed contracts

CRM & integrations

Voice, text and representative tools use the same authorized APIs for customer data, knowledge and business actions.

Implemented core versus extensions. Voice and custom text chat already share the authenticated Dataverse case API through the Assist service. The native workspace uses Dynamics permissions directly. API Management, enterprise workflow events, document-level ACL propagation and the external-IVR context adapter below remain proposals, not deployed safeguards. Caller-ID matching does not authenticate the synthetic CRM profile.

Historical Azure-only inventory / checked 6 Oct 2026

Earlier Azure-only stack

This preserves the earlier environment's regions, resource counts, models and custom assist route. It is not a current inventory of the Dynamics-native deployment.

What changed. The current baseline adds Dynamics-owned telephony, Dataverse CRM and the native workspace. Native voice bypasses the legacy app-number handover and assist transcript feed. The app resources remain in the template; CRM cases no longer use Cosmos. Do not copy this dated inventory as current sizing or regional policy.

Provider migration history / 6 Oct 2026

Before / after

These snapshots show the earlier change from Azure Realtime to the HUMAIN adapter. They explain the provider swap, not today's complete telephony or CRM architecture.

Later changes are separate. Dynamics-native calls and Dataverse CRM are now implemented. These historical figures retain their original browser/ACS endpoints, profile-based email and custom assist feed. Native calls use /dynamics/native, verified customer-only media and the native workspace instead; see the current view.

Before production. The native path is not a production-readiness or Microsoft-certification claim. Validate licensing, recording consent, customer authentication, residency and retention, permissions, concurrency and recovery in the target tenant. Review SBC and external-IVR support only if choosing those separate proposals. Extra numbers or replicas do not remove provider limits or the native single-call guard.

Communications roadmap. Check the supported ACS Direct Routing and Call Automation path before choosing it for production. Microsoft's ACS retirement and breaking-changes guide announces the retirement of ACS Direct Routing, Email and direct-offer number management on September 30, 2028, along with calling/API changes. Onboarding restrictions began on 23 October 2026 for retiring services; an existing deployment does not establish a new tenant's eligibility. Supported Teams-aligned scenarios continue with required SDK/integration changes. Teams Phone support in this template is work in progress; see the ACS retirement notice in the root README. Confirm the target with Microsoft and Dynamics before provisioning.

Current limitations. Dynamics-owned inbound AI calls and native queue handover are implemented. The CRM scope remains synthetic; matching a number is not authentication. Check automatic case selection and linking, Case Details, Pause AI acoustics and non-admin access, summary quality and analytics speaker roles in each deployment. Automatic post-handover language detection is unresolved. Enterprise workflows and per-user knowledge ACLs are separate proposed extensions. The 5-7 second first-audio delay is on hold.

Artwork and accessibility. The Azure, Dynamics 365/Contact Center, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Entra ID icons retain their original shapes and colors. They label the corresponding Microsoft products. Customer telephony and business systems use generic symbols. The HUMAIN waveform is a placeholder: the supplied packages and linked Microsoft collection did not contain an official HUMAIN logo. Azure, Dynamics 365, Entra and Power Platform icon terms apply. Font and layout license notices remain embedded in the HTML and standalone exports. Tabs support Left/Right, Home/End and direct links. Without JavaScript every view remains readable; download controls are disabled.
